mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_attempts ( idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, amount_jpy, status, external_payment_id, order_id ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{amountJpy}, #{status}, #{externalPaymentId}, #{orderId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, amount_jpy, status, external_payment_id, order_id, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_attempts WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, amount_jpy, status, external_payment_id, order_id, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_attempts WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.idempotency_key, a.request_fingerprint, a.amount_jpy, a.status, a.external_payment_id, a.order_id, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM payment_attempts a JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'TIMEOUT') ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, amount_jpy, status, external_payment_id, order_id, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_attempts WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
